name: Zhejiang grandwall electric science&technology co.,ltd.
summary: Zhejiang grandwall electric science&technology co.,ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, develops, produces, and sells electromagnetic wire products in China and internationally. The company offers round and rectangular wire products, as well as engages in manufacturing business. It serves industrial motor, new energy, power tools, automotive, home appliance, and instrumentation sectors. Zhejiang grandwall electric science&technology co.,ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Huzhou, China.
